Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service operation impersonating Sophos cybersecurity vendor
Encrypts files using AES256-CBC encryption with PKCS#7 padding
Prompts affiliate for victim token, contact email, jabber address, and 32-character password used in encryption
Connects to command and control server to verify token
Creates ransom note (information.hta) in each folder with encrypted files
Changes Windows desktop wallpaper to display fake Sophos branding
Attack Vector: Affiliate uses encryptor with victim token to encrypt files on victim device
